tutorial.centre: **Winning a trick does not give you its cards.** They pile up here and are gathered in only when **the same player wins two tricks in a row** (the last trick is the one exception). How many tens are sitting here is what the next trick is really for.
tutorial.scores: The hand is decided by **how many of the four tens you take**, and the judgement is asymmetric: the non-dealer's side wins with two, the dealer's side needs three. Taking all four — or winning seven hands in a row — is a "kot".
tutorial.playerHand: Your hand. You must follow the led suit, and only the legal cards are highlighted. Your partner is CPU 2 opposite; your neighbours are always opponents.
tutorial.playButton: Select a card and press Play. The question is never "can I take it" but **can I take this one and the next**.
tutorial.resetButton: The reset button starts a new game.
